original_question: Design a Verilog module named `bitwise_or`. The module has inputs `A` (8 bits), `B` (8 bits), `enable` (1 bit), and `clk` (1 bit), and an output `result` (8 bits). The module should perform a bitwise OR operation on inputs `A` and `B`. This calculation should be prepared whenever the inputs change and `enable` is high. The final output `result` should be updated synchronously on the positive edge of the `clk` signal with the most recently computed (and enabled) OR value.
